verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a merchant's store data. "Design fast with AI" is about theme design, and "liability insights" in Shopify Tax is not described as AI-generated. The MCP servers and the AI Toolkit connect external agents and coding tools to Shopify; they are adjacent building blocks, not in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
